function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

Here’s a quick snapshot of the **next major festivals happening in the United States** (sorted by start date). All dates are for 2026 and are subject to change, so be sure to double‑check the official festival websites for the most up‑to‑date information.

| Festival | Dates (2026) | Location | Type | Highlights |
|----------|--------------|----------|------|------------|
| **Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival** | **June 9–12** | Manchester, Tennessee | Music & Arts | 4‑day lineup featuring rock, hip‑hop, electronic, and folk; art installations; food trucks; “Bonnaroo” community vibe |
| **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** | **June 17–19** | New Orleans, Louisiana | Jazz & Cultural | World‑class jazz, blues, funk, and local Creole music; street parades; food stalls; “Jazz Fest” atmosphere |
| **Taste of New Orleans** | **June 24–27** | New Orleans, Louisiana | Food & Culture | 4‑day culinary celebration; live music; cooking demos; “Taste of the City” series |
| **Summerfest** | **July 1–4** | Milwaukee, Wisconsin | Music & Family | 4‑day festival with 200+ stages; pop, rock, country, EDM; family‑friendly activities |
| **Taste of Chicago** | **July 7–10** | Chicago, Illinois | Food & Culture | 4‑day food festival; live music; cooking competitions; “Taste of the City” series |
| **Taste of the City – New York** | **July 14–17** | New York City, New York | Food & Culture | 4‑day culinary showcase; live music; cooking demos; “Taste of the City” series |
| **Taste of the City – Los Angeles** | **July 21–24** | Los Angeles, California | Food & Culture | 4‑day food festival; live music; cooking competitions; “Taste of the City” series |
| **Taste of the City – San Francisco** | **July 28–31** | San Francisco, California | Food & Culture | 4‑day culinary celebration; live music; cooking demos; “Taste of the City” series |

### Quick Tips

- **Tickets**: Most festivals sell tickets online months in advance. Look for early‑bird discounts or VIP packages if you want premium seating or backstage access.
- **Travel**: Book flights and accommodations early—especially for Bonnaroo and Summerfest, which attract large crowds.
- **Weather**: June–July in the U.S. can be hot and humid, especially in the South. Pack sunscreen, a hat, and plenty of water.
- **COVID‑19**: Check each festival’s health & safety guidelines. Some may still require proof of vaccination or a negative test.

---

#### Want More Details?

If you’re interested in a specific festival (e.g., lineup, parking, accommodation options) or a different type of festival (e.g., film, art, food, tech), let me know and I can dive deeper!
